items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: Uh, the Elder Humphrey, Willie Humphrey's daddy, his daddy. Uh, he worked with us, you know, in and out.

ctx.x: Yeah, and uh, movies I worked at. And then I made some, uh, I started running on the booth playing music from, from the air, DCB Cooley. Uh, he had a brother got a big steam laundry and uh, Monroe, I started running from near Camden, Arkansas, in Washington, playing music. Uh-huh. I was playing music. Uh, uh, uh, Allen Gordett and Tillman, you remember Tillman the Beast? Yeah. Yeah. He was playing saxophone at that time. And uh, and uh, Ben Allen, he was playing piano at that time.
